Full status and contract response, real persisted graph where applicable
Create+read-back; changed PATCH+read-back; actual DELETE followed by absence; actual close/reject/revoke/replace/void outcomes

LeadScoreOverrideController_revoke uses a separate approved override and verifies score fallback

All three sales-intelligence PATCH operations perform actual changed updates
